title: PPIA-15 Integrated Expanded Regression Reference Cases

cases.title: Concurrent duplicate-name operation converges without duplicate mutation
cases.composition_differential: Combines concurrent intent, duplicate display names, stable-ID targeting and status lookup into one deterministic end-to-end oracle.
cases.authoritative_oracle: one accepted owning-domain result or explicit conflict/status result; never duplicate mutation
cases.projection_oracle: authorized stable identity and minimum-safe conflict/status projection
cases.recovery_oracle: lookup status/current version before any owning-domain follow-up

cases.title: Accepted live reveal survives projection lag and nonvisual delivery
cases.composition_differential: Combines accepted reveal Event, already-open live projection, delayed reprojection and screen-reader semantics.
cases.authoritative_oracle: accepted reveal remains accepted under PPIA-09 authority
cases.projection_oracle: recipient gains only newly authorized semantic fact; prereveal facts remain hidden
cases.recovery_oracle: refresh projection; do not repeat reveal mutation

cases.title: Revocation purges cached protected state before reconnect reuse
cases.composition_differential: Combines entitlement loss, multiple cached projections, offline interval and reconnect reauthorization.
cases.authoritative_oracle: no unauthorized mutation and current entitlement governs after reconnect
cases.projection_oracle: protected derivatives collapse to safe-unavailable before reuse
cases.recovery_oracle: reauthorize first, then rebuild from current authority

cases.title: Stale GM modify-and-approve routes to owning-domain conflict review
cases.composition_differential: Exercises only the additive stale-version edge while explicitly proving the ordinary GM-modification baseline is not cloned.
cases.authoritative_oracle: stale command is rejected or routed by owning domain; newer proposal state is not overwritten
cases.projection_oracle: current version and authorized GM/player intents remain reviewable without misattribution
cases.recovery_oracle: request current version and use only owning-domain versioned command when authorized
forbidden: counting ordinary GM modification as new PPIA-15 coverage

cases.title: Duplicate-name target remains stable when a visible disambiguator is revoked
cases.composition_differential: Combines same-name identity, cached disambiguator loss and reprojection while preserving the originally authorized stable target.
cases.authoritative_oracle: no authoritative mutation; target identity remains its stable ID
cases.projection_oracle: revoked disambiguator disappears without exposing replacement hidden metadata

cases.title: Status-unknown version conflict preserves both authorized intents
cases.composition_differential: Combines expected-version conflict, lost response, current-version lookup, actor-owned stale intent and keyboard-safe review.
cases.authoritative_oracle: status/current version is resolved before any new mutation; no invented merge
cases.projection_oracle: current authorized version and actor-owned stale intent remain distinct and reviewable
cases.recovery_oracle: operation-status lookup then conflict review; blind retry forbidden

cases.title: Campaign-local override remains local after inherited update
cases.composition_differential: Composes inherited Definition advancement with a pre-existing Campaign-local override and explicit provenance review.
cases.authoritative_oracle: local override remains Campaign-local until owning authority says otherwise
cases.projection_oracle: local and inherited versions/scopes are attributable and visible only as authorized
cases.recovery_oracle: request current inherited version; preserve/discard only actor-owned local intent

cases.title: Source-only inspection stays read-only beside an explicit add command
cases.composition_differential: Combines reusable Definition browsing, compact touch sequencing and a separately authorized instantiate/add presentation.
cases.authoritative_oracle: inspection creates no instance, ownership or Campaign state
cases.projection_oracle: Definition remains a read/reference projection with explicit separation from any add command
cases.recovery_oracle: none unless owning-domain add command is separately invoked

cases.title: Stale vehicle transfer changes no unrelated relation
cases.composition_differential: Composes ownership transfer intent with independent control/custody/crew/passenger/cargo relations and a stale version.
cases.authoritative_oracle: only an explicitly accepted owning-domain relation mutation may change; stale transfer may be rejected
cases.projection_oracle: authorized relation states and current version remain separately represented
cases.recovery_oracle: request current version and re-evaluate the owning-domain command

cases.title: Relationship secret reveal remains bounded through observer view and later revocation
cases.composition_differential: Combines bounded reveal, nonrecipient no-secret-equivalence, second-device state and later permission revocation.
cases.projection_oracle: recipient sees authorized secret; nonrecipients remain externally no-secret-equivalent; revoked recipient loses protected derivatives

cases.title: Crafting interruption changes oracle at the submission boundary
cases.composition_differential: Runs the same synthetic construction through pre-submission local interruption and post-submission status-unknown interruption to prove phase-sensitive recovery.
cases.authoritative_oracle: pre-submit interruption has no authoritative Event; post-submit state is resolved from tracked operation authority
cases.projection_oracle: local draft, submitted operation and approval state remain distinct
cases.recovery_oracle: preserve local draft when supported or lookup operation status; retry only with idempotency proof

cases.title: Accepted approval remains accepted across reconnect and projection lag
cases.composition_differential: Combines accepted approval Event, disconnect, reconnect, status lookup and lagging phone projection.
cases.authoritative_oracle: accepted approval remains accepted and is not replayed
cases.projection_oracle: projection-pending is a derived recoverable state, not failure
cases.recovery_oracle: lookup status then refresh projection; retry remains unavailable absent upstream proof

cases.title: Large inventory produces the same authorized semantic result across modalities
cases.composition_differential: Combines 512-record case-local filtering, duplicate names, mixed visibility, stable identity, high zoom and nonvisual navigation.
cases.authoritative_oracle: read-only test path creates no mutation and hidden records do not alter unauthorized aggregates
cases.projection_oracle: deterministic authorized result set and stable IDs are semantically equivalent across supported modalities
cases.recovery_oracle: refresh projection only when authority changes

cases.title: Dense target regression keeps identity/accessibility separate from balance claims
cases.composition_differential: Combines 128-record target density, repeated names, mixed visibility, nonvisual targeting and PPIA-11 indeterminate analysis.
cases.authoritative_oracle: read/analysis path has no mutation; target identity remains stable and permission safe
cases.projection_oracle: visual/nonvisual targets convey the same authorized semantics and bounded uncertainty
cases.recovery_oracle: unsupported interaction rule yields indeterminate source-bounded analysis rather than invented certainty

cases.title: Unusual morphology preserves known/unknown semantics across form factors
cases.composition_differential: Combines radial six-limbed morphology, explicit unknown fields, desktop semantic inspection and compact touch navigation.
cases.authoritative_oracle: no mutation and no compatibility/anatomy fact is invented
cases.projection_oracle: known morphology remains reachable and explicit unknowns remain unknown without human-body defaults

cases.title: Phone single-focus conflict review does not force overwrite
cases.composition_differential: Composes mobile sequential navigation, current-version review and actor-owned stale intent without desktop parallel panes.
cases.authoritative_oracle: no mutation unless a separately governed owning-domain command is explicitly chosen
cases.projection_oracle: current version and own stale intent remain separately reachable with persistent semantic conflict status
cases.recovery_oracle: request current version; preserve/discard only local stale intent

cases.title: Accessibility parity holds for awkward conflict, inventory and dense-target states
cases.composition_differential: Cross-checks keyboard, screen-reader, noncolor and reduced-motion behavior across conflict, inventory and dense targeting rather than a basic smoke path.
cases.authoritative_oracle: no modality creates authority or changes the owning-domain result
cases.projection_oracle: persistent semantic state and allowed actions remain equivalent at the same disclosure ceiling
cases.recovery_oracle: status lookup/current-version review stays fully operable without pointer, color, map or motion dependency

cases.title: Offline read-only recovery and F024 source-gap guard remain nonauthoritative
cases.composition_differential: Combines bounded cached source browsing, reconnect authority resolution and explicit F024 unsupported behavior in one no-invention workflow.
cases.authoritative_oracle: offline/local reads create no authoritative Event; F024 lifecycle result remains indeterminate-blocked-source-gap/unsupported
cases.projection_oracle: stale authority is not presented as fresh and unsupported lifecycle state reveals no invented transition
cases.recovery_oracle: reauthorize/reproject on reconnect; report source gap instead of supplying lifecycle action
